decisions.reason: The request makes template delivery a project-conclusion condition but does not change the already separate final-PDF deliverable or its Heyzine handoff.
Requiring delivery of the editable template does not alter any article-whitespace balancing rule or fill-content constraint.
The source establishes a template handoff condition and does not revise, cancel, or satisfy the digital launch deadline.
Template delivery does not change which tribute page or articles must be included in the issue.
The template handoff condition does not modify the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color rules.
The source does not revise the flat-plan basis, article placement, tribute placement, or editorial ordering.
Requiring the template to be delivered does not alter the requirement to enhance publication images when needed.
The source does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
Template delivery has no necessary effect on author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
The source does not change the selected body typeface, weight treatment, or readability constraint.
The template handoff condition does not modify how long article text should be broken up or when additional images should be requested.
The source does not modify the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
